definitions.explanation: The currency of Japan, specified as 'Japanese yen' when distinguishing it from other currencies in financial, business, or international contexts.

examples.japanese: {日本円|にっぽんえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{支払|しはら}い→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦ドル→ドル：01554_doru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{日本円|にっぽんえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{両替|りょうがえ}→両替：03680_ryougae⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I exchanged dollars for Japanese yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{送金|そうきん}→送金：09774_soukin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、{日本円|にっぽんえん}{建|だ}て⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦ドル→ドル：01554_doru⟧{建|だ}て⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}べる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: For overseas remittances, you can choose between yen-denominated or dollar-denominated.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{日本|にっぽん}→日本：00320_nippon⟧ (Japan) + ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (yen). Used when explicitly distinguishing Japanese yen from other currencies; in domestic everyday contexts, plain ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ is sufficient. Also pronounced にほんえん, but にっぽんえん is more formal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本円|にっぽんえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{両替|りょうがえ}→両替：03680_ryougae⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exchange into yen
- {日本円|にっぽんえん}{建|だ}て: yen-denominated
- {日本円|にっぽんえん}⟦{換算|かんさん}→換算：07992_kansan⟧: yen conversion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: yen — the base term, sufficient in domestic contexts
- ⟦ドル→ドル：01554_doru⟧: dollar
- ⟦ユーロ→ユーロ：27956_yuuro⟧: euro
